title: The robot that can do your entire job better than you

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If a robot could do your job better, what happens to your role in society—and how do we prepare for that future?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current AI and robotics can automate repetitive tasks, but full job replacement requires advanced vision, dexterity, and contextual reasoning—still in early development.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Mass unemployment and loss of identity could follow if we don't ensure equitable access to new opportunities and retraining programs.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are designing systems with human collaboration in mind, like AI-assisted decision-making tools that enhance rather than replace human work.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI handles routine work, freeing humans to focus on creativity, ethics, and complex problem-solving.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t about replacement—it’s about redefining work, responsibility, and the human-AI partnership.
